about: Plasma's desktop shell package holds the lock screen (kscreenlocker loads lockscreen/LockScreen.qml from it), CompactApplet.qml, which opens every panel applet's popup, and the on-screen display (plasmashell loads osd/Osd.qml from here, not from the global theme). Its LockScreenUi.qml is replaced by the Windows 11 lock screen in files/lockscreen/ while Plasma's file is the one of plasma-workspace 6.3.6 (Debian 13); CompactApplet.qml (plasma-desktop-data 6.3.6) places the Start menu's popup over the middle of the taskbar; the OSD (files/osd/) is Windows 11's volume flyout at the bottom of the screen; views/Panel.qml (plasma-desktop-data 6.3.6, sha of the test copy 62077494...) draws the taskbar's accent glow and colour wave (files/shell/TaskbarTint.qml) and shows its focus box only for keyboard navigation; everything else in the shell stays Plasma's.

replacements.why: the taskbar's accent glow and colour wave (Windows 11's taskbar in the theme and accent colour)
the panel draws TaskbarTint over its background, under the applets
no focus box around a taskbar button clicked with the mouse (the search box got one); it still shows while moving through the taskbar with Tab, as Windows does
replacements.new:
// VeltOS: only for keyboard navigation (Tab), like Windows 11's focus rectangles.
        visible: panel.active && panel.activeFocusItem
                 && (panel.activeFocusItem.focusReason === Qt.TabFocusReason
                     || panel.activeFocusItem.focusReason === Qt.BacktabFocusReason)

        imagePath: "widgets/tabbar"

replacements.why: Windows 11's volume/brightness flyout at the bottom of the screen: the OSD window is tall enough for its bottom edge (KWin centres OSDs at two thirds of the screen) to end just above the taskbar
the flyout itself: a rounded card with the icon, a Windows 11 slider and the percentage, gliding up and fading in
Windows 11 lock screen: time and date, then account picture and password box
Start opens centred over the taskbar like Windows 11: an empty item in the middle of the panel window (which spans the screen) to place the popup over
the Start menu and search use the centred item as their popup's visual parent while the taskbar's buttons are centred, their own button with a left-aligned taskbar
no second box around taskbar buttons that draw their own (Start, quick settings, the clock) and none behind the search box while its window is open, as Windows 11
flyouts slide in from the taskbar like Windows 11 (KWin's sliding popups effect)
